# Configuration keys

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from noust.core.config.DEFAULT_CONFIG. Do not edit by hand: change the code, then run the script. -->

Every configuration key and the value it has until you change it. Set one with `noust config set KEY VALUE`, read it with `noust config get KEY`; the file is `/etc/noust/config.yaml`. What each setting does, and the ones that are obsolete, is in [the configuration guide](CONFIG.md). A key that holds a secret is shown as empty here and masked everywhere Noust prints it.
